<div class="card-body">
'''Jawa Siesta''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/141635851/7eT-P2gSH0emheAeAmgCUQ.jpg Jawa Siesta original photograph].</ref>

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ジャワの昼寝</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">場の自分の側に配備する。敵味方のフォースデッキから3フォース消費して配備する。さもなければ配備できない。すべてのジャワは、没収値が＋1される。</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">真昼のモス・アイズリーで、体力を温存するため涼しく昼寝している3人のジャワ。</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Jawa Nap.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. To deploy, use 3 Force from both players' Force Piles. Otherwise it cannot be deployed. All Jawas have their forfeit increased by 1.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Three Jawas taking a cool nap at midday in Mos Eisley to conserve their energy.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese applies the forfeit bonus to all Jawas. The English limits it to “All your Jawas.” The Japanese title literally means “Jawa Nap.”<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-L-jawasiesta.gif|Jawa Siesta original English printed face]].</ref>
